resolution_notes: Disputed free_tier_limits, rate_limits, and cors: checked official TheMealDB API docs (api.php), FAQ, and live API response headers (2026).
free_tier_limits: Free test key "1" for development/education; free full-list capped at ~100 items. Premium (~$10 lifetime) unlocks V2 endpoints, full listing, and production key.
rate_limits: No published rate limits; FAQ states unlimited usage.
